international.title: General Synod could vote to ban C of E clergy from supporting Restore Britain
international.summary: Private members’ motion comes amid concern about Christian symbols being appropriated by the far right Church of England clergy could be banned from joining or supporting the hard-right Restore Britain party under a motion put forward for debate at the General Synod. The move is an attempt to replicate the decision by bishops 17 years ago prohibiting clergy from belonging to or supporting the British National party , declaring its policies incompatible with church teaching on racial equality.
